remarks: Nestled at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac on a private 1.95-acre wooded setting, this inviting four-bedroom Colonial offers a wonderful blend of privacy, comfort, and convenience. The thoughtfully designed floor plan is ideal for everyday living and entertaining, featuring a welcoming living room with a brick fireplace, an adjoining dining room, and a bright sunroom overlooking the natural surroundings. The kitchen offers wood cabinetry, granite countertops, a center island, and generous workspace. Hardwood floors enhance much of the home, while four spacious bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations on the upper level. Step outside to the expansive deck and enjoy the peaceful wooded backdrop. Additional highlights include central air, a full attic, an unfinished lower level with abundant storage or future finishing potential, and an electrical panel equipped with generator transfer switches. Conveniently located just minutes from Trader Joe's, shopping, restaurants, parks, the Merritt Parkway. A rare opportunity to own a home with the space, flexibility, and setting that complements your lifestyle.
